soldier: Major soldier: head, labrum, antennae and pronotum yellowish brown, abdominal tergites and legs paler, mandibles dark brown, white where the anteclypeus meets the mandibular base; about ten long setae around the anterior half of the middle of the labrum, three to four on the postclypeus, about ten in the median area of the pronotum, one long seta at each of the angular lobes of the mesonotum and metanotum. Head nearly rectangular, broader in the middle and slightly narrower behind, the posterior margin almost straight; the left mandible smooth above the middle, with minute serrations below the middle that become coarser towards the base; labrum ligulate, longer than wide, the transparent apex almost a rounded triangle and blunt; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 almost equal to segment 2; postmentum rectangular, broader in front and narrower and parallel below the waist. Pronotum widest, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle and the posterior margin markedly concave in the centre; mesonotum narrowest. Medium soldier paler; head oval, widest about the posterior third; mandibles rather slender and straight; posterior margin of the pronotum concave in the middle. Minor soldier even smaller, resembling the medium soldier and paler still.
